Definition: a wrapped (and unformed mass, i.e. as the embryo)
BiblicalUsage: gôlem is the word for an unformed substance, an embryo. In Psalm 139:16, the text says "Thine eyes did see my substance."
TheologicalSignificance: In gôlem I find no hidden theology; it simply means an unformed substance, an embryo.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
